items.title: Istanbul hit by its worst floods in over 80 years, with 4 dead
items.summary: ABC News, NBC and The Tribune report that Turkey's interior minister called the flooding the worst in more than 80 years, and the death toll has reached four. Turkish Minute says five people were still missing and more rain was forecast. Reports differ on the details of the deaths and missing counts, so figures are provisional.
items.why: Extreme weather disrupting a major commercial hub affects logistics, insurance and supply chains, and shows why crisis communication plans matter for brands.
items.src: ABC News, NBC News, The Tribune, Turkish Minute

items.title: Istanbul got more rain in 48 hours than its September and October average combined
items.summary: Anadolu Agency, as relayed by ABC News, says the rain fell in the 48 hours up to Thursday morning, 15 October, and the interior minister reported 9,850 damage reports with 46,000 personnel on cleanup.
items.why: Numbers like these show how fast a local event becomes a business continuity problem for firms with operations in the region.

items.title: DoT orders caller name display on 4G and 5G networks from 1 November
items.summary: The Tribune and Deccan Herald report a Department of Telecommunications circular dated 13 October that makes operators roll out Calling Name Presentation. Recipients see their saved contact name first, then the name held by the caller's operator, and overseas calls show as international. Users who opted for Calling Line Identification Restriction stay hidden. Some outlets say 'all callers', but the circular covers operator-held names.
items.why: Verified caller names change how outbound sales and recruiter calls are received, which matters for marketing outreach and HR screening calls.

items.title: First tranche of the India-US trade deal is finalised and in legal drafting, says Goyal
items.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said on 15 October that the first tranche has been finalised and is going through legal drafting. The Commerce Secretary said signing depends on the US finishing its broader tariff framework. Earlier target dates, including November 2025 and mid-March 2026, were missed.
items.why: A trade deal affects tariffs on Indian exports and prices of imported brands, which feeds into hiring and pricing plans.
items.src: The Tribune, Deccan Herald, The Federal

items.title: Caller name display excludes 2G, 3G and landlines for now
items.summary: The DoT said CNAP on 2G, 3G and landline networks will be considered separately after further examination.
items.why: The first phase reaches only smartphone users on 4G and 5G, which is most of the audience brands and recruiters call.

items.title: Sensex and Nifty gain for a second day as IT stocks lead
items.summary: HDFC Sky and other reports say the Sensex rose 413.66 points, or 0.56%, to 74,729.27 on 16 October. The Nifty 50 ended near 23,146.15, though one outlet gives 23,119.00, so the Nifty figure is provisional. Gains were concentrated in large caps, with the midcap index down 0.12% and smallcaps flat. One report ties the rally to SEBI's VWAP relief and softer US Treasury yields.
items.why: Market direction shapes corporate budgets and IPO appetite, which affect campus hiring and marketing spend.
items.src: HDFC Sky, India TV News, SolarQuarter

items.title: The Sensex closed at 74,315.61 on 15 October before the 16 October gain
items.summary: Reports on the 16 October close cite 74,315.61 as the previous session's Sensex close and 22,997.35 for the Nifty.
items.why: Day-to-day moves matter less than the two-day IT-led trend a placement season is read against.

items.title: Reflection AI's Beam is a 501B open-weight model aimed at Chinese open models
items.summary: VentureBeat, DataCamp and The Rundown describe Beam as a mixture-of-experts model with 501B total and 23B active parameters. Reflection reports 80.1 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and claims a 3x to 4x cut in estimated compute versus GLM-5.2. Sources conflict on release timing and licence terms, and the benchmark scores are the company's own, so treat these as provisional.
items.why: Cheap, capable open models change what HR and marketing teams can build in-house instead of buying AI tools.

items.title: Google reported to keep Gemini 4 Argon limited to vetted cybersecurity experts
items.summary: An AI news aggregator says Google is holding back its most powerful model from the public over misuse concerns. An earlier digest said Argon was available through the Gemini API, so the access picture conflicts and is provisional.
items.why: Staged access to frontier AI shows how companies manage risk, a live case for brand trust and governance.

items.title: Beam supports a context window of up to one million tokens
items.summary: DataCamp and Trending Topics describe Beam as text-only with up to a one million token context window.
items.why: Long context lets one model read whole policy manuals or candidate files in one pass, relevant to HR automation.
